name: Entity Share Bypass Fields (Plugin)
description: Entity Share Client import processor that drops missing or admin-named fields from incoming synced entity data so imports survive schema drift.
project_description:
In some cases, an entity type may slightly be different (have a little more or a little less fields) from one Drupal to another. Unfortunately, Entity Share does not support this case and will break while trying to synchronize your entities. This module allow you to avoid this problem by bypassing missing fields.

 
In some other cases, you'll want to bypass/exclude some specifics fields from the synchronization. The module allow it you too. 

 Features 
 This module allow you to bypass automatically missing fields. It also allow you to bypass manually some fields too.

 Post-Installation 
 Once installed, you've to update you entity share config import on your entity share client.

You should find a new processor called "Bypass Fields". Enable it.

Once enable when you'll synchronized entities it will automatically bypass missing fields.

 If you want to add manually fields to bypass you have to go to your entity share client import config. Go to Processors setting section. You'll find "Bypass fields" inside. Select it and in the text area add the machine name of your fields. If you have to bypass more than one field, you'll have to coma separated them.
